Name: Complex Cooking - Cooking Skill and Kitchen Overhaul
Author: vcsama
Description:
[size=6][b]Complex Cooking[/b][/size]

Bring your kitchen to life with hands-on cooking inspired by Overcooked. Prepare 80 vanilla dishes through chopping, mixing, heating, baking, cooling, and assembly, with a Cooking skill, professions, food quality, and illustrated recipe guides.

[b]Languages:[/b] English and Simplified Chinese. Other languages fall back to English.

[size=5][b]Cooking and progression[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Keeps vanilla ingredients and quantities unless another mod changes a recipe. No extra water or mandatory seasoning is required.[/*]
[*]Click a learned recipe to view its illustrated guide. The cooking menu still shows ingredient availability.[/*]
[*]Preparation and heat control use timing minigames. Cooking levels make preparation easier and widen the ideal heat zone. Mixing, baking, and cooling run automatically.[/*]
[*]Level Cooking from 0 to 10, unlock recipes, and choose professions at levels 5 and 10. Specialize in ingredient refunds, extra servings, sale value, or restorative effects.[/*]
[*]Make ordinary, silver, gold, and iridium dishes. Ingredient quality and cooking performance affect the result, with increased quality-based sale values.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Kitchens and cookware[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Farmhouse:[/b] the first house upgrade unlocks the kitchen; the second adds another set of core workstations. Farmer's Store users can choose which kitchen system the building uses.[/*]
[*][b]Island Farmhouse:[/b] repair the house to use a full kitchen, with a relocated fridge that retains its inventory, a two-plate rack, and counter storage.[/*]
[*]Carry cookware with its contents, move it between compatible workstations, and serve food on plates. Complex Cooking plates are unlimited and need no washing. Frying pans keep their default appearance regardless of player direction.[/*]
[*]Counter surfaces use the currently loaded vanilla farmhouse textures and follow replacements of those textures.[/*]
[*]To empty a container, use the inventory trash can: recover one original ingredient with its quality intact, discard the remaining contents, and keep the container. Collected finished dishes use normal trash behavior.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Optional compatibility[/b][/size]

Generally compatible with kitchen retextures that preserve the vanilla layout. Counters follow the replaced textures for a consistent look.

[size=4][b]Farmer's Store — 1.0.3[/b][/size]

Choos e the kitchen system separately for each farmhouse, multiplayer cabin, or store building. Enter the building, then open [b]GMCM → Complex Cooking → Current building kitchen[/b]. You can also choose a default for buildings without an individual setting. The host controls these choices in multiplayer.

[list]
[*][b]Farmer's Store kitchen:[/b] use its tools and cooking workflow. Upgraded farmhouses retain vanilla cooking. This is the default when Farmer's Store is installed.[/*]
[*][b]Complex Cooking kitchen:[/b] use our manual workflow. Upgraded farmhouses retain their built-in Complex Cooking kitchen and can have extra stations; other indoor buildings use purchased stations.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Buying and placing equipment[/b]

[list]
[*]Buy cutting counters, mixers, empty stoves, ovens, fridges, plate racks, and counters from [b]Focus on shelves for twenty years[/b]. Buy frying pans, deep pots, and steamers from [b]Open a treasure store[/b]. Unlock suppliers and the food-sales license through Farmer's Store normally.[/*]
[*]Counters cost [b]100g[/b]. All other Complex Cooking stations and cookware cost [b]2,000g each[/b]. Equipment is purchased rather than crafted.[/*]
[*]Every empty stove accepts a frying pan, deep pot, or steamer. Multiple stations retain separate contents.[/*]
[*]One-tile counters join side by side and front to back; each holds one item. Plate racks rotate between front, right, and left before placement.[/*]
[*]Place equipment with left-click. Empty it before removing it with a pickaxe. Empty cookware is returned with its stove; return a mixer's bowl before removing the mixer.[/*]
[/list]
Our plated dishes can be served directly. Default menu prices account for dish quality and the maker's profession bonus. Manual prices take priority, and existing orders keep their captured prices. Remove and relist old menu entries to apply the new defaults.

Complex Cooking kitchens hide redundant native kitchen equipment, clean plates, kitchen waste bins, dishboards, and sinks from suppliers. Customer pickups no longer generate dirty plates. Farmer's Store kitchens retain their original plate and cleaning workflow.

Tables, order counters, serving counters, delivery, and business accounting remain part of Farmer's Store. Purchases enter its ledger and are settled through its normal business rules. Empty ingredients, unfinished food, and dishes before switching systems; purchased equipment is retained.

[size=4][b]Cornucopia and Wildflour[/b][/size]

Added recipes keep their own ingredients, unlock conditions, outputs, and crafting methods. They do not automatically gain Complex Cooking minigames or manual Cooking XP.

Vanilla recipes altered by another mod use their current recipe data instead of an incompatible manual guide. Added ordinary ingredients can be placed on our counters. Farming and machine-processing systems remain with their respective mods.

[size=4][b]Restauranteer — original 1.1.1[/b][/size]

Cook orders with Complex Cooking's tools in the default Saloon kitchen. Open the fridge to take out supplied ingredients, use the plate cabinet, and store items in seven spaces along the front bar. Restauranteer keeps its own orders, stocking, payments, and friendship rewards. Cooking skill and XP are shared with your other kitchens.

Enable Restauranteer's default Saloon map patch; its event-unlock requirement still applies.

[size=4][b]Better Crafting — 2.18.0[/b][/size]

Enable [b]ReplaceCooking[/b] to use its search, categories, and cooking browser. Supported dishes open their preparation guides and still require manual cooking. Other recipes continue through Better Crafting's normal crafting rules. Complex Cooking's Alt-click pinned guides and Better Crafting's native favorites are separate.

[b]All integrations are optional.[/b] Without these mods, the existing farmhouse and Island Farmhouse kitchens work normally. Purchasing placeable equipment requires Farmer's Store; GMCM is recommended for its kitchen settings.

Custom Saloon and Island Farmhouse maps require separate layout support; unrecognized layouts are left unchanged. Mods that change kitchen layouts or cooking systems may need separate compatibility.

[size=5][b]Qi Seasoning[/b][/size]

Hold Qi Seasoning and left-click a finished dish on a kitchen counter or in cookware. One seasoning raises one normal or silver serving to gold. Extra servings are seasoned separately.

Gold, iridium, and already-seasoned dishes use none. Raw ingredients and unfinished food cannot be seasoned. Seasoning is optional and manual; it preserves the original cooking score, perfect-cooking status, XP, and first-time rewards.

[size=5][b]Guides and controls[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Left-click:[/b] pick up, place, add ingredients, and serve. In a minigame, make one timing attempt.[/*]
[*][b]Q near a manual workstation:[/b] open its minigame. Inside a minigame, pause or resume.[/*]
[*][b]Esc:[/b] exit the minigame and keep progress.[/*]
[*][b]Alt + left-click a recipe:[/b] toggle a shared pinned guide, marked by a gold border.[/*]
[*][b]Mouse wheel over pinned guides:[/b] browse additional rows. Pinned guides can be viewed outside the kitchen too.[/*]
[*][b]Hover over containers:[/b] inspect their ingredients.[/*]
[*][b]Placeable equipment:[/b] left-click to place; right-click while holding a plate rack to rotate it. Right-click a placed fridge to access its inventory.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Coffee Maker:[/b] hold at least three Coffees and left-click a placed Coffee Maker to exchange three Coffees for one ordinary-quality Triple Shot Espresso. This grants no Cooking XP and leaves the machine's daily Coffee untouched.

[size=5][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

All players need the same Complex Cooking version and matching SpaceCore versions. Use matching relevant integration mods when running a shared restaurant. Browse recipes together and cook at separate stations; each manual workstation allows one player at a time. Pinned recipe favorites are shared.

When all online players are in cooking minigames or pausable menus, the world clock pauses while kitchen minigames and devices continue running. Same-device split screen is unsupported.

[size=5][b]Requirements and installation[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley:[/b] developed against 1.6.15.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI:[/b] tested with 4.5.2. Download from [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi.io[/url].[/*]
[*][b]SpaceCore:[/b] 1.28.4 or later, installed separately. Download from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Nexus Mods[/url].[/*]
[/list]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and SpaceCore.[/*]
[*]Extract the ComplexCooking folder into the game's Mods folder. The correct path is Mods/ComplexCooking/manifest.json.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI, then open a kitchen's cooking menu to view recipe guides.[/*]
[/list]
For updates, close the game, back up your save, and replace the old ComplexCooking folder. Keep your old config.json if you want to retain settings. Keep only one copy of the mod, and update all multiplayer participants together.

Developed on Windows; other operating systems have not been verified.

[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]

Thanks to ConcernedApe, the SMAPI and SpaceCore developers, my boyfriend Tzd for his inspiration and company, and everyone providing feedback and multiplayer testing.

This is an independent fan project inspired by Overcooked, with no official affiliation. AI tools assisted with code and some artwork.


[b]────────────────[/b]


[size=6][b]简体中文说明[/b][/size]

来做铱星菜！复杂料理参考《胡闹厨房》的动手做菜体验，为原版 80 道菜加入切配、搅拌、加热、烘焙、冷却和组合流程，以及厨艺技能、职业、料理品质和菜谱示意图。

[b]语言：[/b]简体中文和英文，其他语言回退英文。

[size=5][b]做饭与成长[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]沿用原版材料和数量；其他模组修改配方时，按实际配方制作。无需额外加水或强制添加调料。[/*]
[*]点击已学习的菜谱查看流程图，菜单仍会显示原料是否足够。[/*]
[*]备料与控火使用时机判定小游戏；厨艺升级会降低备料难度、扩大理想火候区域。搅拌、烘焙和冷却自动完成。[/*]
[*]厨艺从 0 级升至 10 级，升级解锁菜谱，并在 5 级、10 级选择职业，可专精原料返还、额外产出、售价或食用恢复效果。[/*]
[*]成品分普通、银星、金星和铱星，品质受原料与操作表现影响，并有提高后的品质售价倍率。[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]厨房与厨具[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]农舍：[/b]首次升级房屋后解锁厨房，第二次升级增加一套主要工位。安装农夫小店时，可选择建筑使用哪套厨房系统。[/*]
[*][b]姜岛农舍：[/b]修复后可使用完整厨房，包含保留库存的移位冰箱、两格盘架和置物台。[/*]
[*]厨具可以连同内容物搬动，在兼容工位间移动，再将料理装盘。复杂料理的盘子无限取用，无需清洗。平底锅保持默认外观，不随站位改变方向。[/*]
[*]台面使用游戏当前加载的原版农舍素材，随对应贴图美化变化。[/*]
[*]通过物品栏垃圾桶清空容器时，可以选回一份原始食材并保留品质，其余内容倒掉，容器留下。已领取到背包的成品按普通方式丢弃。[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]可选兼容[/b][/size]

兼容保留原版厨房布局的美化模组，台面会随对应贴图变化，保持风格统一。

[size=4][b]农夫小店（Farmer's Store）1.0.3[/b][/size]

可为农舍 、联机小屋和店铺建筑分别选择厨房系统。进入目标建筑，在 [b]GMCM → Complex Cooking → 当前建筑厨房[/b] 中设置；也可设置未单独指定建筑使用的默认厨房。联机由主机选择。

[list]
[*][b]农夫小店厨房：[/b]使用它的厨具和做菜流程，升级后的农舍保留原版厨房。安装农夫小店时默认使用这一选项。[/*]
[*][b]复杂料理厨房：[/b]使用我们的手动做菜流程。升级农舍保留自带的复杂料理厨房，还能添加额外工位；其他室内建筑使用购买的工位。[/*]
[/list]
[b]购买与摆放[/b]

[list]
[*]在[b]专注货架二十年[/b]购买砧板台、搅拌台、空灶台、烤箱、冰箱、盘子架和置物台；在[b]开店百宝店[/b]另购平底锅、深锅和蒸屉。供应商和食品经营许可按农夫小店的正常流程解锁。[/*]
[*]置物台 [b]100g[/b]，其余我们的工位和锅具均为 [b]2000g／件[/b]。设备通过购买获得，不提供制作配方。[/*]
[*]空灶台可放任意一种锅具，多台工位分别保存内容。[/*]
[*]单格置物台支持左右、前后拼接，每格放一件物品。盘子架可在放下前切换正面、朝右、朝左。[/*]
[*]左键放置设备，取空内容后用镐子回收。空锅可随灶台拆下并返还；搅拌台拆除前需归还搅拌碗。[/*]
[/list]
我们的成品可直接上菜。菜单默认价计入料理星级和制作者职业加成，玩家手动标价优先，已接订单保留点单时的价格。旧菜单取下重新上架后采用新默认价。

选择复杂料理厨房时，采购界面隐藏重复的厨房设备、空盘、厨余垃圾桶、碗碟台和水槽，客人取餐不再生成脏盘子。选择农夫小店厨房则保留原有盘子和清洗流程。

餐桌、点餐台、上菜台、配送和营业记账继续使用农夫小店的系统。采购先记入经营账目，按它原有规则结算。切换厨房前先取走原料、半成品和料理；已买设备保留。

[size=4][b]聚宝盆（Cornucopia）与野面粉（Wildflour）[/b][/size]

新增菜谱保留各自的材料、解锁条件、产量和制作方式，不会自动变成复杂料理小游戏，也不额外发放手工厨艺经验。

原版菜谱被其他模组修改时，按当前实际配方制作，不再打开不匹配的手工指南。新增的普通食材可以放在我们的置物台上；种植和机器加工系统仍由各模组负责。

[size=4][b]Restauranteer 原版 1.1.1[/b][/size]

在默认酒吧厨房使用复杂料理厨具制作订单。冰箱可打开供料库存，橱柜可取还空盘，前方吧台提供七格置物位。点单、供料、报酬和好感继续由 Restauranteer 管理，厨艺等级与经验和其他厨房共用。

需要启用 Restauranteer 的默认酒吧地图改动，并遵守其原有事件解锁条件。

[size=4][b]Better Crafting 2.18.0[/b][/size]

启用 [b]ReplaceCooking[/b] 后使用其搜索、分类和做饭菜单。复杂料理支持的菜谱会打开流程指南，仍需手动做菜；其他菜谱沿用 Better Crafting 原有制作规则。复杂料理的 Alt＋左键流程图收藏与 Better Crafting 原生收藏分别保留。

[b]以上兼容模组均为可选。[/b]不安装也能正常使用原有农舍和姜岛厨房。购买可摆放工位需要安装农夫小店；推荐安装 GMCM 调整厨房设置。

自定义酒吧和姜岛农舍地图需要单独适配，不符合默认布局时不会自动改建。改变厨房布局或做菜系统的模组可能需要额外兼容。

[size=5][b]齐氏调味料[/b][/size]

手持齐氏调味料，左键点击厨房台面或厨具里的成品，消耗一份，将一份普通或银星料理提升至金星。额外产出的料理分别调味。

金星、铱星和已调味料理不消耗，原料和未完成的料理不能调味。调味为可选手动操作，保留原始评分、完美判定、经验和首次奖励。

[size=5][b]菜谱与操作[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]左键：[/b]拿放、投料、装盘；小游戏内进行一次判定。[/*]
[*][b]工位旁按 Q：[/b]打开手动加工小游戏；小游戏内暂停或继续。[/*]
[*][b]Esc：[/b]退出小游戏并保留进度。[/*]
[*][b]Alt＋左键点击菜谱：[/b]收藏或取消共享流程图，金色边框表示已收藏。[/*]
[*][b]悬停流程图并滚动滚轮：[/b]切换显示行，离开厨房也能查看收藏。[/*]
[*][b]悬停容器：[/b]查看原料内容。[/*]
[*][b]可摆放工位：[/b]左键放置；手持盘子架时右键旋转。已放置的冰箱右键打开物品栏。[/*]
[/list]
[b]咖啡机：[/b]手持至少三杯咖啡，左键点击已放置的咖啡机，每次三杯换一杯普通品质的三倍浓缩咖啡，不增加厨艺经验，也不影响机器当天原有的咖啡产出。

[size=5][b]多人联机[/b][/size]

所有玩家使用相同版本的复杂料理和一致版本的 SpaceCore，涉及经营兼容时也应安装相同的相关模组。可以同时查看菜谱、在不同工位做菜；一个手动工位同时限一人操作。收藏流程图为全体共享。

所有在线玩家都在料理小游戏或可暂停菜单时，世界时钟暂停，小游戏和厨房设备继续运行。目前不支持同机分屏。

[size=5][b]安装与运行要求[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]星露谷物语：[/b]以 1.6.15 开发。[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI：[/b]已使用 4.5.2 验证，前往 [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi.io[/url] 下载。[/*]
[*][b]SpaceCore：[/b]单独安装 1.28.4 或更新版本，前往 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Nexus Mods[/url] 下载。[/*]
[/list]
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI 和 SpaceCore。[/*]
[*]将 ComplexCooking 文件夹解压到游戏的 Mods 文件夹，正确路径为 Mods/ComplexCooking/manifest.json。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏，打开厨房的烹饪菜单查看流程图。[/*]
[/list]
更新前退出游戏、备份存档，再替换旧文件夹。如需保留设置，留存旧 config.json 并放回。只保留一份模组，联机玩家统一更新。

开发平台为 Windows，其他操作系统尚未验证。

[size=5][b]致谢[/b][/size]

感谢 ConcernedApe、SMAPI 和 SpaceCore 开发者，感谢男朋友 Tzd 提供的灵感与陪伴，也感谢参与反馈和联机测试的玩家。

本模组为独立同人项目，与《胡闹厨房》官方无关联。开发过程中使用了 AI 工具辅助代码和部分美术制作。
